name: Inuya Komaru
source:
[b]A puppy-like kouhai you just can't resist petting[/b]

A quite puppy-like kouhai.
When she is happy, it's so obvious that you could almost hallucinate a non-existent tail wagging behind her.
Curious and prone to sticking her nose into everything, she loves trying out things she has newly learned.
She tends to guard her accident-prone best friend, [url=/c144265]Sachi[/url], like a protective watchdog.
But beware: if you make her angry, she'll chomp down on you without mercy.

[Translated from official user's manual]
